rows.definition: The operator-configured exclude / include_only gate that drops a discovered account row from the fleet registry, extracted from the inline discovery checks so the discovery path and the seat-stamping path share one decision.
rows.distinction: Not the policy document itself (policy-manifest) and not a refusal verdict (policyblock): it is the per-row filter decision derived from an already-loaded manifest, and it is the operator-configured counterpart to the structural exclusion checks.
